title: 2026 Red Bull Tennessee National Downhill Race - Windrock Bikepark
content: Full race broadcast, pro women and pro men finals, with commentary. Positive examples: many pro riders on identical features. Negative examples: crash list below.
timestamps_source: commentary in YouTube auto-captions; refine cut points against harvester shot list in data/harvest/shots/

segments.notes: Broadcast intro, track walk and course preview (Windrock Bike Park, Tennessee; hard-pack dirt, whoops, rock sections, Red Bull drop near the finish). Rider profiles, seeding recap.

Pro women finals, run order from ~9:21 (first rider Anna Newkirk). Zana Logar sets benchmark 2:53.54 at 11:50. Kailey Skelton (reigning US champ) ~18:24. Eleonora Ostgaard wins, back-to-back, ~25:54. Winner interview ~27:29. Broadcast + trackside angles, multiple riders on the same features.

Pro men finals from ~29:10 (Luca Shaw opens). Dooley into hot seat ~34:02. Pinkerton crashes ~42:29 (2 s up, clipped a tree on an off-camber, elbow tucked). Dante Silva ~46:59, crashed at top of his run. Dylan Maples ~55:06. Aaron Gwin crashes ~60:21-60:24 while 2.2 s up (came in too fast on a diagonal route behind a rock). Austin Dooley wins ~61:26.
Post-race analysis and podiums. Commentary: number one and two seeds (Gwin, Shaw) both crashed; nobody had a smooth run.

crashes.notes: Off-camber, pinched against tree, body position upset. Was 2 s up.
